_source: Master of Orion II diplomacy and event text, from assets/moo2-strings.json (tools/extract_moo2_text.py). Selected by eye on 2026-10-17 from 81 candidates a filter left; the rest were interface text. Lore only: read by the Imperial Historical Wire and by the Antaran intrusion fault, never after a real story.
diplomatic: Although I do not take any pleasure in continued contact with you, there is business to settle between us.
Although I have enjoyed our conversation, I am needed elsewhere.
Although we already have all we need, we agree to a Trade alliance in the spirit of charity.
Although we prefer to live at peace, we need to expand. Therefore, we have a new policy: to take what we need, at your expense.
Both our empires will benefit from the Research treaty you propose. Offer accepted.
Do you think that we are unaware of your espionage? Offer refused!
Have you not noticed there is a war going on? No one is available to speak to you now.
It is not worthwhile to maintain our other treaties if you no longer agree to the trade treaty. All treaties are canceled.
Leave us alone, we are tending to internal affairs.
Never. We will never agree to that as long as you keep attacking our fleets.
Our emperor has declared war. When all is said and done, only one empire will remain.
Our scientists shared much information. We are saddened that you are no longer interested in furthering the advancement of your people.
So be it. You defy the ruling of the council. Now you will feel the wrath of the New Republic!
Sorry, the ambassador is unable to talk with you now.
The Trade treaty is accepted. May both our peoples prosper from it!
The blockade must fall before we can even begin to consider such an offer.
The cries of those killed by your biological weapons fill our ears. We cannot hear your offer.
The research treaty between our empires is a great benefit to us all. Thanks for honoring the agreement.
The tribute you suggest is accepted in the spirit of friendship.
There is no need for both our races to continue to suffer in this war. Let us declare peace, and there will be joy throughout the galaxy.
There will be no diplomatic negotiations while we are at war.
United, none can stand against us. We accept the proposed Alliance.
We accept your decision, but declare war anyway.
We accept your proposal. Both our empires will benefit from a freedom from hostilities.
We are still rebuilding the damage your saboteurs caused. Our trust is not so easily repaired.
We are still too saddened by your last Council vote to entertain the thought of accepting your offer.
We do not approve of biological weaponry. If you use one again, we will systematically destroy your entire empire.
We have decided to do you the honor of entering into war with you. You are lucky: we only do battle with those we respect.
We have more pressing matters to attend to at this time.
We have not forgotten your last sabotage incident. Until you have proven to be more trustworthy we will not deal with you.
We have tried to bolster the failing diplomatic relationship between our Empires, but this can go on no longer. No more talking, now we go to war.
We will either weaken you to the point that you will vote any way we like, or we will destroy you utterly. It really matters little to us!
With feelings of pride for those who fought valiantly and despair for those that fell in battle, we hereby accept your offer of peace.
You are a thief, not an Emperor. We reject your proposal.
You are crazy. We will not deal with someone blockading our system!
You show your true colors by sending your evil spies to steal our technology. Cease, or we will be at war.
Your impetuous actions have lead to war!
Your offer is generous but we must decline at this time.
Your proposal has been rejected. Perhaps your wealth does not give you as much power as you imagined.
Your proposal sounds insincere, coming from the lips of the commander of the troops attacking our fleets.
Your spies are not welcome in our territory, and your proposals are not welcome in this diplomatic assembly.
Seeing you defeated will not be enough. It is your death, and the extinction of your entire race that I look forward to!
court: The galaxy is lucky to have a leader as great as you!
The galaxy stands united behind you, the most glorious Emperor of all time.
We are overjoyed to join in the United Galactic Republic with you as our leader.
We will follow wherever you may lead, oh great and glorious Emperor!
With you as our leader, all is well in the galaxy tonight!
You are the greatest Emperor ever. We are honored to join with you.
You are the one true ruler of the galaxy!
antaran: All your petty squabbling with the other beings in this galaxy are meaningless. The Antaran fleet will destroy you all, one by one.
We have come to eradicate all life forms from this galaxy. You cannot stand against us.
We have returned to continue our purification of this galaxy.
We the Antarans have come to extinguish you from this galaxy!
You have been found unfit to exist within the same galaxy as the mighty Antarans.
